approaches.title: Greedy balance with wildcard reserve
approaches.summary: Tracks a running parenthesis balance and uses wildcard characters as reserve when unmatched closing parentheses appear. The revision is marked incorrect.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a greedy balance-and-reserve strategy using wildcard counts to compensate for unmatched parentheses. Marked wrong.

approaches.title: Minimum and maximum possible open counts
approaches.summary: Maintains the range of possible unmatched opening-parenthesis counts while scanning the string. It rejects prefixes that cannot be valid and checks that zero unmatched opens is achievable at the end.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced the flawed greedy tracking with min/max possible open counts, handling wildcards as either opening or closing parentheses.
